boundary_derivation: Use the organizer's canonical six equal chronological slices over the complete visible-development index; Team05 supplies no hand-dated boundaries.
required_partition_properties: six contiguous pairwise-disjoint test slices in chronological order
no test observation enters prior fold state
purge every 168-hour A5 label that crosses a fold endpoint
model_rule: Instantiate a clean frozen deterministic UDCC strategy in each fold. It has no fitted coefficients or learned state; each artifact still binds exact source, config, seed, risk policy, schedule, and fold dates.
stitching_rule: Stitch test returns once in fold order with no gap, overlap, discarded fold, or training return.
admissibility_condition: A7 must accept the exact candidate registration, then the official run must bind all candidate-specific fold, target, return, A5, and conditional-tape artifacts.
